newsitem.title: GERMANY: German financial publisher Norman Retrop to expand.
newsitem.headline: German financial publisher Norman Retrop to expand.

text.p: German financial publisher Norman Rentrop said on Friday it had posted an eight percent increase in turnover in 1996 to 146 million marks and planned to expand its business in the loose-leaf periodical market.

The company, one of Germany's seven largest trade publishers, said it was increasing its investment in financial consulting materials with three new newsletters reporting on Bonn, Berlin, Brussels, Zurich and Washington.
The Bonn-based Norman Rentrop said it also planned to invest more venture capital in financial information services.
